gains — What was gained or lost, realized and unrealized, over a window (default: the last twelve months). view=summary: one row: realized, unrealized at the start and end, change, gain = realized + change, share of value with a cost basis. sources, portfolios, accounts: the same per entity; they add up to the summary. positions: per account and holding. realized: each lot sold, as the tax document or statement states it or the lot engine rebuilt it. lots: the open lots at the window's end. coverage: per account, where the figures are blind. check: the lot engine against the stated lots and cost bases. quality names every gap. Example: {view: "realized", from: "2025", to: "2025"}.

Parameters (all optional):
  from         Window start; snaps to the unit's start.
  to           Window end; snaps to the unit's end. Default today unless the tool says otherwise.
  view         summary | sources | portfolios | accounts | positions | realized | lots | coverage | check. Which rows to return (default summary).
  period       daily | weekly | monthly | quarterly | annual | total. Bucket size on summary, sources, portfolios, accounts (default total: one row for the whole window).
  documents    primary | all. realized only: each sale once (primary, default) or every document's copy (all).
  newest_first realized only: newest first (default false: oldest first).
  source       Keep this source id only (e.g. "schwab"); a comma list keeps several.
  account      Keep rows whose account name, id or nickname contains this (case-insensitive).
  symbol       positions, realized and lots: keep only rows whose symbol or name contains this text.
  asset_class  positions only: keep only this asset class (e.g. public_equity, fixed_income, private_equity).
  term         realized and lots: short or long.
  tax_wrapper  accounts and coverage: keep only this tax wrapper (e.g. taxable_joint, roth_ira).
  missing_basis ignore | zero. Not on coverage and check: a missing cost basis is blank (ignore, the default) or counts as 0 (zero; quality then says basis_assumed_zero=N); the config's lots.missing_basis sets the default.
  currency     Output currency, e.g. USD or CHF. Default: the configured one.
  filter       Conditions, all of which hold: ["value > 1000", "date >= 2025-07", "category not in Rent, Groceries"].
  search       Keep rows with this text in any cell.
  columns      "default", "all", names, or "+add,-remove"; describe(topic=<tool>) lists them.
  sort         Column to sort by; "-" for descending. "-value": the main money column, largest first whatever the sign.
  max_chars    Most characters the result may take (default 16000); the page ends at a row boundary and the last line says how to get the rest.
  limit        Most rows to return (default: as many as fit).
  offset       Rows to skip (default 0).
  format       table | csv | json. Result format (default table).

Columns (* = shown by default; columns=all shows every one):
  summary: period*, period_start, realized_USD*, realized_short_USD, realized_long_USD, realized_other_USD, unrealized_start_USD*, unrealized_end_USD*, unrealized_change_USD*, gain_USD*, proceeds_USD, wash_disallowed_USD, realized_lots, sells, positions, positions_without_basis, basis_coverage_pct*, quality*
  sources: silver_source*, period*, period_start, realized_USD*, realized_short_USD, realized_long_USD, realized_other_USD, unrealized_start_USD*, unrealized_end_USD*, unrealized_change_USD*, gain_USD*, proceeds_USD, wash_disallowed_USD, realized_lots, sells, positions, positions_without_basis, basis_coverage_pct*, quality*
  portfolios: silver_source*, portfolio*, portfolio_id, period*, period_start, realized_USD*, realized_short_USD, realized_long_USD, realized_other_USD, unrealized_start_USD*, unrealized_end_USD*, unrealized_change_USD*, gain_USD*, proceeds_USD, wash_disallowed_USD, realized_lots, sells, positions, positions_without_basis, basis_coverage_pct*, quality*
  accounts: silver_source*, account*, account_id, account_kind, tax_wrapper*, account_nickname, account_category, relationship_id, period*, period_start, realized_USD*, realized_short_USD, realized_long_USD, realized_other_USD, unrealized_start_USD, unrealized_end_USD*, unrealized_change_USD*, gain_USD*, proceeds_USD, wash_disallowed_USD, realized_lots, sells, positions, positions_without_basis, basis_coverage_pct*, quality*
  positions: silver_source*, account*, account_id, account_nickname, symbol*, name, position_key, asset_class*, vehicle, currency*, quantity_start, quantity_end, cost_basis, cost_basis_USD*, market_value, value_USD*, unrealized_start_USD, unrealized_end_USD*, unrealized_change_USD, realized_USD*, gain_USD*, unrealized_pct, basis_stamp*, acquisition_date, lots, quality
  realized: silver_source*, date*, undated, account*, account_id, account_nickname, symbol*, description, instrument_id, quantity*, acquired*, term*, covered, form_8949_box, held_days, proceeds*, cost_basis*, gain*, wash_disallowed, accrued_market_discount, gain_origin, disposal*, currency*, proceeds_USD, cost_basis_USD, gain_USD*, document, tax_year, primary, basis_stamp, lot_id, source_document
  lots: silver_source*, snapshot_date, account*, account_id, account_nickname, symbol*, name, position_key, lot_id, acquisition_date*, held_days*, term*, covered, quantity*, cost_basis*, market_value*, value_origin, unrealized_gain*, unrealized_pct, currency*, cost_basis_USD, value_USD, unrealized_gain_USD, basis_origin, source_document
  coverage: silver_source*, account*, account_id, account_nickname, tax_wrapper*, value_USD*, value_with_basis_USD*, basis_coverage_pct*, basis_stamps*, open_lots*, sells*, realized_lots*, documents*, verdict*, sells_rebuilt*, positions_rebuilt, seed_lots, lot_mode, lot_methods
  check: check*, silver_source*, account*, account_id, account_nickname, tax_year*, items*, quantity, engine_cost_USD*, stated_cost_USD*, cost_delta_USD*, engine_gain_USD, stated_gain_USD, gain_delta_USD*

Filters each view takes (a filter the view lacks moves the call to the first finer view that has it):
  summary: none
  sources: source
  portfolios: source
  accounts: source, account, tax_wrapper
  positions: source, account, symbol, asset_class
  realized: source, account, symbol, term
  lots: source, account, symbol, term
  coverage: source, account, tax_wrapper
  check: source, account

gain = realized + unrealized_change, the price gain on what is held; income, fees and taxes are in returns. Realized is what the sale's documents state, else what the lot engine rebuilt from the trades; unrealized is the clean value (market value less accrued interest) less the cost basis. basis_stamp says which notion of cost basis a figure is. summary, sources, portfolios and accounts add up. The quality column names every gap (describe topic=quality); the coverage view says per account where the figures are blind, and the check view compares the lot engine with the stated lots.
Example: {view: "accounts", from: "2025", to: "2025", tax_wrapper: "taxable_joint"}.

This endpoint redacts amounts, quantities, account numbers and the names taken off statements (merchants, payers, narratives), and shows a name a person typed about an account as a pseudonym such as manual-1, or as its account number, redacted; source ids, other account names, holdings and their names, categories and shares stay visible.
